def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

import json,os
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    guide_col=None; guide_row=None
    for j in range(w):
        col={g[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(col)==1 and next(iter(col))!=bg: guide_col=j; gc=next(iter(col))
    for i in range(h):
        row=set(g[i])
        if len(row)==1 and next(iter(row))!=bg: guide_row=i; gr=next(iter(row))
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,gc)]
    sc=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    if guide_col is not None:
        # vertical guide; move shape adjacent right of guide
        width=max(j for _,j in cells)-min(j for _,j in cells)+1
        newj=guide_col+1
        out=[[gc if j==guide_col else bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg
        i0=min(i for i,_ in cells)
        for i in range(i0,i0+max(i for i,_ in cells)-i0+1):
            for j in range(newj,newj+width): out[i][j]=sc
        line_j=newj+width
        for i in range(h): out[i][line_j]=8
    else:
        height=max(i for i,_ in cells)-min(i for _,i in cells)+1
        newi=guide_row+1
        out=[[gc if i==guide_row else bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=bg
        j0=min(j for _,j in cells)
        for j in range(j0,j0+max(j for _,j in cells)-j0+1):
            for i in range(newi,newi+height): out[i][j]=sc
        line_i=newi+height
        for j in range(w): out[line_i][j]=8
    return out
